def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(version):
        # Split by '+' to remove build metadata
        version_without_build = version.split('+')[0]
        
        # Split by '-' to separate core version and pre-release
        if '-' in version_without_build:
            core, prerelease = version_without_build.split('-', 1)
        else:
            core = version_without_build
            prerelease = None
        
        # Parse core version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
        parts = core.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        if prerelease:
            prerelease_identifiers = prerelease.split('.')
            # Convert to tuple of (is_numeric, value) for comparison
            prerelease_tuple = tuple(
                (True, int(identifier)) if identifier.isdigit() else (False, identifier)
                for identifier in prerelease_identifiers
            )
        else:
            # No pre-release means it sorts after pre-release versions
            prerelease_tuple = None
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_tuple)
    
    def compare_key(version_with_index):
        version, index = version_with_index
        major, minor, patch, prerelease_tuple = parse_version(version)
        
        # For sorting: versions with pre-release come before same version without
        # None > tuple, so we need to invert: use (False,) for no prerelease, (True, prerelease_tuple) for prerelease
        if prerelease_tuple is None:
            prerelease_sort_key = (False,)
        else:
            prerelease_sort_key = (True, prerelease_tuple)
        
        # Return tuple for sorting; index maintains stable sort for equal precedence
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_sort_key, index)
    
    # Add original indices to maintain stable sort
    indexed_versions = [(v, i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    
    # Sort by the comparison key
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=compare_key)
    
    # Extract just the version strings
    return [v for v, _ in sorted_versions]
